title: Variational Inference Using a Differentiable Multigrid Linear Solver
summary: Gradient-based Bayesian inference methods require efficient access to Jacobian and adjoint-Jacobian operators of high-dimensional forward models. While multigrid solvers provide near-optimal complexity for elliptic partial differential equations, they are rarely available in forms compatible with automatic differentiation (AD). We develop a differentiable multigrid solver for steady-state diffusion-absorption problems and derive its adjoint operations analytically through the full multigrid hierarchy.
